description: 防災ヘリポート一覧 [airports and heliports and fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 砥部町. 砥部町の防災ヘリポート. Coverage: 砥部町. The portal files it under the publisher 砥部町. Its tags are 位置情報, 防災ヘリポート. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-01-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
